tonight.headline: Kicker fixed. Nothing left to do today
body: You added Eddy Pineiro and dropped Loveland at 16:19 UTC, exactly as the morning card said. ESPN now projects you 119.6 to JuiceJam's 112.0, a 54% chance. Your lineup as set is the projection lineup.
JuiceJam still start Nico Collins, whom Houston have ruled out, with Jameson Williams (11.0) on their bench. Nothing on your side needs a move before Sunday.

case.label: The Collins hole
case.body: Collins is out for a second straight week (PlayerProfiler, NBC Sports). If JuiceJam swap in Williams they project about 123. That's a real risk to a 54% number, and it's theirs to fix, not yours.

case.label: Your Monday back
case.body: Barkley is off the injury report and was a full participant by Saturday (NBC Sports, PhillyVoice). He plays Monday night at Chicago.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: JuiceJam leave Collins in. Then you're roughly 7-8 ahead on ESPN's projection going into Sunday.

case.label: Re-checked this afternoon
case.body: Recomputed from the 21:53 UTC snapshot, now with Pineiro rostered: your best lineup goes 119.7 to 123.4, Team 13's 123.4 to 125.1. Lamar is still in slot 20 behind Allen in slot 0; White still starts at RB2. On season projections both best lineups gain too (you +46.2, them +22.5).

case.label: Honest risk
case.body: Raw season numbers look lopsided: Lamar 297.3, Tuten 166.9. That's why it's a longshot. Tuten is no longer needed as Barkley's cover: Barkley is off the injury report.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Team 13 start a second real back or trade a quarterback, Lamar lands on Baltimore's report, or Barkley is ruled out and Tuten has to start. Don't send it again. Only respond if they open the conversation.

trades.copyText: Hi, would you do Lamar for Bhayshul Tuten? Lamar sits behind Allen and can't score for you, and Tuten goes straight into your RB2 ahead of White. That's about +1.7 a week to your lineup. Propose it in ESPN if you're in.

worthALook.name: Adonai Mitchell
worthALook.lead: The receiver sharing targets with your own starter.

case.label: The role
case.body: 12 targets in Week 2 against Wilson's 7 (week archive). TE Mason Taylor is out again.

case.label: The injury
case.body: Questionable with the finger, limited Friday with the hand heavily wrapped. The Jets signed Jamaal Pritchett and elevated Sterling Shepard to cover for him (Yahoo, 26 Sep), which is a team hedging.

case.label: When to act
case.body: If he out-targets Wilson again at Detroit. Wrong if Wilson draws nine or more and Mitchell fewer than six. Free agent, so no priority, but the only open seat went to the kicker.

worthALook.name: Josh Downs
worthALook.lead: A real role now, and still no seat.

case.label: The role
case.body: A team-best 22.0% target share and 89% and 83% of snaps in the first two weeks. Alec Pierce is rehabbing his ankle without surgery, so the IR stint may run four weeks or more (DK Network). He drew 9 targets in Week 2 (week archive).

case.label: Why not now
case.body: The next seat would be Vele's, and Downs projects 12.0 to Vele's 11.6. That isn't worth a move with Golden and Lloyd locked and Kamara inside the churn window.

case.label: When to act
case.body: If Downs draws eight or more targets against Houston, swap him for Vele when rosters unlock. He's a free agent, so it costs no priority.

case.label: The comparison
case.body: ESPN has the 49ers 7.3 against Arizona and the Jaguars 7.1 against New England. SI list the 49ers as a streaming start because Arizona have scored the eighth-fewest points. The Steelers (7.3) are on waivers and would cost priority.

case.label: Why hold
case.body: A 0.2 gap, and that seat changed hands on Thursday.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing this week. Revisit after 2 October when the churn window on the D/ST seat closes.

doNotChase.name: Tyler Shough
doNotChase.lead: He projects above Lawrence and he's free. The case for him is box scores.

case.label: The case for
case.body: ESPN projects him 17.8 to Lawrence's 16.4.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: This quarterback slot has already lost 42.8 points to chasing. Lawrence has no injury tag and there's no role fact to override on.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Lawrence getting hurt. You carry no backup, so Shough is the free-agent answer then.

doNotChase.name: Tank Bigsby
doNotChase.lead: A handcuff to your own back, and Barkley is playing.

case.label: The fact
case.body: His rise (1 opportunity, then 16) came while Barkley played through the stinger. Barkley is now off the injury report and full by Saturday (NBC Sports, PhillyVoice).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Barkley ruled out for more than a week and Bigsby named the lead. Tuten covers first either way.

doNotChase.name: Josh Jacobs
doNotChase.lead: The best-looking name on the wire, and he isn't playing.

case.label: The fact
case.body: Placed on the Commissioner's Exempt List on 31 August (NFL.com, ESPN). A search this afternoon found no reinstatement. ESPN's DAY_TO_DAY label is wrong.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: The NFL reinstates him AND Green Bay activate him. Even then, Lloyd is already yours.

waiverAnalysis.summary: Eight risers and one faller from two weeks of data, which is thin. Loveland left the roster on the morning card, so Gadsden is the only faller, and he holds because he's the only healthy Chargers tight end. None of the risers is an add: no seat clears the churn rule, and the best riser (Marks) is in a timeshare.

falling.name: Oronde Gadsden
falling.roleReason: Njoku and Kolar are both on IR, so he is the only healthy TE on the 53-man roster; Harbaugh: 'a lot of confidence in Oronde's game' (Yahoo)
falling.action: HOLD and start; the vacancy is his role
